games.name: Shan Koe Mee
games.description:
This mini-game was sponsored by M9 Asia Myanmar.

Designed for fans of strategy and luck, this version is built strictly for entertainment. No real money, no risks—just pure, offline gameplay against our smart AI. Whether you’re a seasoned pro or a beginner looking to learn the rules, this app offers the perfect digital playground.

🃏 How to Play
The rules stay true to the Myanmar traditions you know and love:

The Deck: Played with a standard 52-card deck.

The Deal: Every player starts with 2 cards.

The Score: Your score is the remainder of the sum of your cards divided by 10.

Example: If you have a 7 and an 8 (Total = 15), your score is 5.

The "Koe" (9) or "Eight": If your initial two cards total 8 or 9, it’s a showdown! Everyone reveals their cards, and the highest score wins the round.

The Draw: Feeling unlucky? If your score is lower than 4, you have the option to draw one additional card to boost your total.

🌟 Key Features
100% Free to Play: No real money involved. Play for fun, anytime, anywhere.

Play Offline: No internet? No problem. Challenge our computer AI and sharpen your skills.

Smooth Gameplay: Enjoy clean graphics and an intuitive interface designed for a seamless mobile experience.

Authentic Rules: Perfectly mirrors the traditional Myanmar scoring system.

💡 Why Choose Our Shan Koe Mee?
This app is perfect for those who want to enjoy the cultural heritage of Myanmar gaming without the pressure of gambling. It’s a game of wits, luck, and quick thinking!

Download now and see if you can hit a 9! Shan Koe Mee - The most beloved card mini-game right on your phone

games.name: SPielatus
games.description:
SPielatus – Your Game Night Organizer

You know the problem: Organizing a game night means endless messages across different chats, missed dates, and the eternal question "Who's available when?". SPielatus solves exactly that.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULING
Propose multiple possible dates for your game night. Your fellow players sign up for the dates that work for them. Once the minimum number of participants is reached, the session is automatically confirmed – no more follow-ups needed. Optionally with waitlist support.

GROUP-BASED ORGANIZATION
Create groups for your different gaming circles – whether it's the weekly game night or the big annual session. Manage members, assign roles, and decide who can create game rounds or comment. Groups can be public, closed, or completely private.

When creating a game round, you decide which of your groups it will be published to – or whether it should be publicly visible to everyone.

POLLS & VOTING
Start polls directly in game rounds or in groups: Which game should we play? Who's bringing snacks? Which day should we meet? Three voting modes (single choice, top-3 ranking, multiple choice), anonymous voting possible, game options directly from BoardGameGeek or your group's collection.

INTEGRATION WITH BGG & BGSTATS
Link your BoardGameGeek account and bring all the game intelligence into the app:
• Your BGG collection is automatically imported and kept up to date
• Group collection: See which games are available in the group and who owns them
• Wish system: Mark games (including individual expansions) you'd like to play
• BGG poll options: Pick games with image and info directly from BGG
• BGStats import: Load a play file (.bgsplay) into a round – scores, winner and duration are taken over
• BGStats export: Log the result in BGStats with one tap – game, players, date and venue are pre-filled
• Record results manually: Even without BGStats, you can capture scores & winner directly

NOTIFICATIONS UNDER CONTROL
Over 40 configurable notification types keep you up to date – from new rounds in your groups to signups, waitlist movements and poll results, all the way to invitations and schedule conflicts. All granularly toggleable. The Action Center additionally bundles everything waiting for a decision from you.

MORE FEATURES
• Calendar export: Transfer confirmed and provisional dates directly to your device calendar
• Calendar subscription: iCal feed in Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook – new rounds and changes update automatically (two separate feeds for your own rounds and available group rounds)
• Result history: Game results remain accessible in every completed round
• Venue offers: Players can offer their place as the meeting location
• Conflict detection: Warnings for overlapping schedules
• Personal round defaults: Presets for new rounds (player counts, start time, duration etc.)
• Poll templates: Save recurring polls as personal templates
• Multilingual: German, English, French, Spanish

BY GAMERS FOR GAMERS
SPielatus was developed out of real need – by a board gamer who knew exactly these problems. The app is 100% free, ad-free, and respects your privacy.

Questions or feedback? Write to us at support@spielatus.ch

Stop the scheduling chaos and focus on what matters: playing together. Your game round organizer
